verses.zh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。
verses.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.en: A gentle answer calms anger down, but harsh words stir it up.

verses.zh: 智慧人的舌善发知识；愚昧人的口吐出愚昧。
verses.kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.en: A wise person's tongue uses knowledge well, but a fool's mouth pours out foolishness.

verses.zh: 耶和华的眼目无处不在；恶人善人，他都鉴察。
verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.en: The LORD's eyes are everywhere, watching both the bad and the good.

verses.zh: 温良的舌是生命树；乖谬的嘴使人心碎。
verses.kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.en: A kind tongue is a tree of life, but a twisted one breaks a person's spirit.

verses.zh: 愚妄人藐视父亲的管教；领受责备的，得着见识。
verses.kjv: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.en: A fool looks down on his father's teaching, but taking correction makes a person sensible.

verses.zh: 义人家中多有财宝；恶人得利反受扰害。
verses.kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.en: A good person's house holds much treasure, but what a bad person earns brings trouble.

verses.zh: 智慧人的嘴播扬知识；愚昧人的心并不如此。
verses.kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.en: Wise lips spread knowledge around; a foolish heart does nothing of the kind.

verses.zh: 恶人献祭，为耶和华所憎恶；正直人祈祷，为他所喜悦。
verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.en: The LORD hates what a bad person offers, but the prayer of an honest person makes him glad.

verses.zh: 恶人的道路，为耶和华所憎恶；追求公义的，为他所喜爱。
verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.en: The LORD hates the road bad people walk, but he loves whoever chases after what is right.

verses.zh: 舍弃正路的，必受严刑；恨恶责备的，必致死亡。
verses.kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.en: Leaving the right path brings hard correction, and hating correction leads to death.

verses.zh: 阴间和灭亡尚在耶和华眼前，何况世人的心呢？
verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.en: Even the place of the dead lies open before the LORD — how much more a person's heart!

verses.zh: 亵慢人不爱受责备；他也不就近智慧人。
verses.kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.en: Someone who sneers does not like being corrected, and will not go near wise people.

verses.zh: 心中喜乐，面带笑容；心里忧愁，灵被损伤。
verses.kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.en: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but a sad heart crushes the spirit.

verses.zh: 聪明人心求知识；愚昧人口吃愚昧。
verses.kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.en: A person who understands looks for knowledge, but a fool's mouth feeds on foolishness.

verses.zh: 困苦人的日子都是愁苦；心中欢畅的，常享丰筵。
verses.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.en: Every day is hard for someone who is suffering, but a cheerful heart is like a feast that never ends.

verses.zh: 少有财宝，敬畏耶和华，强如多有财宝，烦乱不安。
verses.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.en: Better to have little and respect the LORD than to have great treasure and live in turmoil.

verses.zh: 吃素菜，彼此相爱，强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。
verses.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.en: Better a dinner of vegetables where there is love than a fat roast where there is hate.

verses.zh: 暴怒的人挑启争端；忍怒的人止息纷争。
verses.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.en: A hot-tempered person stirs up quarrels, but someone slow to anger calms them down.

verses.zh: 懒惰人的道像荆棘的篱笆；正直人的路是平坦的大道。
verses.kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.en: A lazy person's road is like a hedge of thorns, but an honest person's path is a level highway.

verses.zh: 智慧子使父亲喜乐；愚昧人藐视母亲。
verses.kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.en: A wise son makes his father glad, but a foolish person looks down on his mother.

verses.zh: 无知的人以愚妄为乐；聪明的人按正直而行。
verses.kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.en: Foolishness is fun to someone with no sense, but a person who understands walks straight.

verses.zh: 不先商议，所谋无效；谋士众多，所谋乃成。
verses.kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.en: Without talking it over, plans fall apart; with many advisers, they succeed.

verses.zh: 口善应对，自觉喜乐；话合其时，何等美好。
verses.kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.en: It is a joy to give a good answer, and a word at just the right time — how good that is!

verses.zh: 智慧人从生命的道上升，使他远离在下的阴间。
verses.kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.en: For a wise person the road of life leads upward, away from the place of the dead below.

verses.zh: 耶和华必拆毁骄傲人的家，却要立定寡妇的地界。
verses.kjv: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.en: The LORD tears down a proud person's house, but he protects a widow's boundary line.

verses.zh: 恶谋为耶和华所憎恶；良言乃为纯净。
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.en: The LORD hates wicked plans, but kind words are pure to him.

verses.zh: 贪恋财利的，扰害己家；恨恶贿赂的，必得存活。
verses.kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.en: Being greedy for money brings trouble on your own family, but hating bribes brings life.

verses.zh: 义人的心，思量如何回答；恶人的口吐出恶言。
verses.kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.en: A good person thinks before answering, but a bad person's mouth pours out evil.

verses.zh: 耶和华远离恶人，却听义人的祷告。
verses.kjv: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.en: The LORD stays far from bad people, but he listens to the prayer of good ones.

verses.zh: 眼有光，使心喜乐；好信息，使骨滋润。
verses.kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.en: A bright look makes the heart glad, and good news gives strength to the bones.

verses.zh: 听从生命责备的，必常在智慧人中。
verses.kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.en: Whoever listens to correction that gives life will be at home among the wise.

verses.zh: 弃绝管教的，轻看自己的生命；听从责备的，却得智慧。
verses.kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.en: Refusing to be taught means not caring about your own life; taking correction means gaining sense.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的训诲；尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD teaches you wisdom, and humility comes before honour.
